<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="5" fill="#DB6186"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="29" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">9:41</text>
  <line x1="303" y1="25" x2="303" y2="29" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="308" y1="22" x2="308" y2="29" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="313" y1="19" x2="313" y2="29" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="318" y1="16" x2="318" y2="29" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="338" cy="24" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="27" x2="345" y2="31" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <rect x="356" y="17" width="22" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <rect x="378" y="21" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  <rect x="359" y="20" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#DB6186"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="48" cy="93" r="27" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <polygon points="33,94 54,82 67,94 54,91 45,101 45,94" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <line x1="35" y1="105" x2="62" y2="105" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="88" y="91" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#7A1851">airplane</text>
    <text x="88" y="111" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">TRAVEL WITH CONFIDENCE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Welcome copy -->
  <text x="30" y="172" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Welcome back</text>
  <text x="30" y="198" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Log in to manage your flights and trips.</text>

  <!-- Email field -->
  <text x="30" y="244" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Email address</text>
  <rect x="30" y="252" width="330" height="58" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.035"/>
  <rect x="30" y="250" width="330" height="58" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="279" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="46,275 53,281 60,275" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="75" y="285" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#A8A8AC">name@example.com</text>

  <!-- Password field -->
  <text x="30" y="343" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Password</text>
  <rect x="30" y="351" width="330" height="58" rx="10" fill="#000000" opacity="0.035"/>
  <rect x="30" y="349" width="330" height="58" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="48" y="374" width="13" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="51,374 51,370 53,367 56,367 59,370 59,374" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="335" cy="378" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="329" y1="385" x2="341" y2="371" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <text x="75" y="384" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="19" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="3" fill="#323232">••••••••</text>

  <!-- Remember and forgot -->
  <rect x="31" y="434" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="34,441 38,445 45,437" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="55" y="447" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Remember me</text>
  <text x="267" y="447" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Forgot password?</text>

  <!-- Login button -->
  <rect x="30" y="478" width="330" height="54" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="476" width="330" height="54" rx="12" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="195" y="510" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Log In</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="30" y1="572" x2="164" y2="572" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="226" y1="572" x2="360" y2="572" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="195" y="577" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">or continue with</text>

  <!-- Social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="598" width="158" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="622" r="9" fill="#2D79ED"/>
    <text x="57" y="627" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
    <text x="76" y="627" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="202" y="598" width="158" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="622" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="229" y="627" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#DB6186">G</text>
    <text x="248" y="627" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Registration prompt -->
  <text x="195" y="691" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Don’t have an account? <tspan fill="#7A1851" font-weight="600">Register now</tspan></text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="744" x2="390" y2="744" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="37,777 49,767 61,777 61,791 37,791" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="34,777 49,764 64,777" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Explore -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="146" cy="778" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="151,772 148,781 140,784 143,775" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="146" cy="778" r="2" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="146" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Explore</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Trips -->
  <g>
    <rect x="231" y="766" width="25" height="24" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="236" y1="773" x2="251" y2="773" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="236" y1="779" x2="251" y2="779" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="236" y1="785" x2="247" y2="785" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="243" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Trips</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account active -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="341" cy="775" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="341" cy="788" rx="13" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="778" r="2" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <text x="341" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#DB6186">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
